string.text: Reusable teleport to the single active Nocturne. Double-click or use a quick slot to arrive beside the trader, facing him. Available during his appearance, from 01:00 to 06:00. Issued when starting a new game in Developer mode.
Nocturne is absent. He appears from 01:00 to 06:00.
The Nocturne route is available on the full Pripyat map.
This teleport is available only in Developer mode.
